one_line: Founder of the Namgyal ruling line in 15th‑century Ladakh, centered on Shey and the middle Indus valley.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy mountain-bred build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium tan Himalayan complexion, straight nose, keen almond-shaped dark brown eyes, thin moustache and short goatee, default expression calm and resolute with a slight, thoughtful frown.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled into a single braided topknot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow dark red woolen band, no grand crown, just a simple bronze circlet sitting low on the forehead.
appearance.costume: A heavy knee‑length maroon woolen chuba (Ladakhi robe) with wide sleeves, worn wrapped left over right and belted at the waist with a broad dark brown leather belt; under the robe, a pale cream wool tunic shows at collar and cuffs; lower body in loose dark indigo woolen trousers tucked into sturdy mid‑calf brown leather boots; over the left shoulder a muted dark green woolen cloak panel drapes diagonally like a practical mantle; minimal ornamentation: a single carved brass amulet box (gau) on a dark cord at the chest and simple bronze wrist cuffs, reflecting a mid‑15th‑century Ladakhi noble but not an over-decorated emperor.
appearance.signature: A straight, single‑edged Ladakhi iron sword with a plain brass cross‑guard and dark wooden hilt, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left hip, often held resting with the right hand on the pommel.

ref_desc: Lhachen Bhagan is a lean, tan Ladakhi noble with a braided black topknot and bronze circlet, wearing a maroon wool chuba over cream tunic, dark indigo trousers, dark green mantle and brown boots, carrying a plain brass‑hilted sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character of Lhachen Bhagan: a lean, late‑30s Ladakhi ruler with an oval tan face, high cheekbones, keen dark brown almond eyes, a thin moustache and short goatee, his expression calm and resolute. His thick black hair is pulled into a single braided topknot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow dark red wool band, and he wears a simple bronze circlet low on his forehead. Dress him in a heavy knee‑length maroon wool chuba wrapped left over right, wide sleeves and a broad dark brown leather belt at the waist; let a pale cream wool tunic show at collar and cuffs. Give him loose dark indigo wool trousers tucked into sturdy mid‑calf brown leather boots. A muted dark green wool mantle panel should drape diagonally from his left shoulder across the torso for extra warmth, with minimal jewelry: a small carved brass gau amulet box on a dark cord at his chest and plain bronze wrist cuffs. At his left hip hangs a straight single‑edged iron sword with a plain brass cross‑guard and dark wooden hilt in a brown leather scabbard, his right hand lightly resting on the pommel. Use maroon, dark indigo, cream, dark green and brown as the dominant colors, and present him standing in a neutral pose suitable for a consistent model sheet, clearly showing face, hair, full costume and sword.
